purpose: Make the local container workflow explicit and reproducible.

local-build.source_of_truth: Dockerfile and the checked-out source revision

published-image.source_of_truth: FGA_IMAGE tag or digest supplied before Compose resolution

host.source_of_truth: the checked-out Python and frontend dependencies

health_contract.database_witness: postgres:16.4-alpine uses pg_isready; it is not silently declared as the SQLite application store

security_boundaries: Compose interpolation is resolved by the invoking environment before a container exists.
env_file values are runtime injection and do not repair missing interpolation variables.
No secret is accepted as a Docker build argument or copied into an image layer.
The repository has a local player/session boundary, not an external identity provider. The smoke test must not call board access authentication.
The optional PostgreSQL profile is a dependency-health witness until a PostgreSQL application adapter is implemented.
